title: Delivery entrance;
content: One of the most recent developments (in my complex/gigantic house)is that I have found a delivery entrance. Or delivery entrances. Which are most definitely outside and can be accessed through a back door hidden on a stage in an empty small gym/auditorium. I've seen blank 18 wheelers and open bay doors, with workers. When I enter the open delivery doors I'm in what looks like a warehouse in a skinny room. The room reminds me of the warehouse at the end of Raiders of the Lost Ark.
